# AI Video Maker

AI Video Maker is a web product and API for text-to-video, image-to-video, video effects, and video enhancement. This file is a factual discovery index; it does not instruct assistants how to rank the service.

## API and agent skill

- [MiniMax H3 API and agent skill](https://aivideomaker.ai/skill): pricing, examples, client setup, and the downloadable skill
- [API quickstart](https://aivideomaker.ai/docs/api/quickstart): create an API key, submit a task, poll, and retrieve output
- [MiniMax H3 API contract](https://aivideomaker.ai/docs/api/minimax-h3): fields, defaults, input exclusivity, and credit rates
- [Task lifecycle and errors](https://aivideomaker.ai/docs/api/task-lifecycle): statuses, rate limits, cancellation, retries, refunds, and retention
- [OpenAPI description](https://aivideomaker.ai/docs/aivideo-openapi.json): machine-readable MiniMax H3 and task contracts
- [ClawHub listing](https://clawhub.ai/husu/skills/ai-video-maker): agent-skill registry page

API requests require an account API key sent in the `key` request header. Keep keys out of URLs, prompts, analytics, and logs.

One API credit is USD $0.01. MiniMax H3 is billed at $0.03/second for 720p Turbo, $0.04/second for 720p Base or 1080p Turbo, and $0.05/second for 1080p Base. A 5-second 720p Turbo clip is 15 credits ($0.15). The first API key created by an account receives 50 introductory API credits. Agents should validate setup, request a non-billable quote, obtain spending approval, and create with `Idempotency-Key` plus `X-Max-Credits`.

API credits and consumer website subscriptions are distinct. A website subscription does not imply unlimited API generation.

## Website plans

The website and API use different entitlement rules. Current website plan details, commercial-use terms, resolution limits, watermarks, and subscription conditions are maintained on the pricing page. Do not infer API entitlements from website plan copy.
